goal: Recognize visible FLOPO traits; species prediction is not trained or used for model selection.

encoders.dinov3: Deferred: gated weights; current credentials do not grant access.

architecture.spatial_views: Whole detected organ plus four overlapping 65%-width/height quadrants; fixed crops, not segmentation.
architecture.concept_head: Learned quality-specific attention over five frozen feature vectors; shared quality and bearer residuals; separate visibility logits.
architecture.quality_identity: Shared only for equal quality IRIs, not label-string matches.
architecture.BioCLIP_initialization: Training-only ridge regression from frozen BioCLIP features to frozen FG-CLIP text/image logits; this baseline is not native BioCLIP zero-shot.

teacher.training_inputs: EXIF-free organ crop, visual definitions and a fixed trait vocabulary only; no species, taxonomy, filenames, URLs or flora profiles.
teacher.outputs: Present/absent/unobservable, confidence and normalized supporting box.
teacher.target_policy: High-confidence observed signs supervise trait heads; unobservable remains unknown for the trait. High-confidence observability states supervise a separate noisy visibility head.
teacher.abandoned_attempt: staged-teacher-v1 stopped after malformed compact JSON. Kept for audit, excluded from training.

transfer_policy: Remove any source disjunction containing a withheld trait; remove direct teacher, visibility and pretrained-anchor training targets for that trait. Shared quality parameters and symbolic implications may transfer. Foundation-model prior knowledge is not removed. Independent arm uses separate quality parameters per phenotype.
sampling: 4 uniformly sampled trait groups per step; uniform supporting taxon within trait; one source event; 8 observation draws (without replacement when possible) and one crop per drawn observation. Same image schedule per seed across arms within regime.
flora_loss: Negative log of average sampled-observation support for positive source disjunctions; detached predicted-visibility weighting in combined arms. Not a numerical population-prevalence constraint. Missing source traits remain unknown. Scoped explicit hair contrasts only.
shuffled_profiles: Permute event targets within organ while retaining the exact original image/trait sampling schedule; no scoped source negatives in this control.
reasoning: Six supported typed marginal implications, soft squared violation loss; not exact WMC/full OWL. Shuffled rules preserve organ and graph degrees.

validation.tests: 86 vision tests passed, including 7 staged supervision/schema/sampling tests.
validation.development_diagnostic: All models scored on existing inspected single-AI leaf-shape audit; no checkpoint/hyperparameter selection. Withheld fruit/petal combinations have no independent reference labels yet.
validation.thresholds: Independent validation only; never old development audit or test set.

operational.workflow: Features and teacher run concurrently. After features: GPU preflight. After preflight and all valid teacher annotations: automatic Slurm submission, model fitting, development diagnostics, download and hash verification. No GPU held waiting for the teacher.

limitations: Teacher errors and self-reported confidence remain uncalibrated.
Detected organ boxes may contain wrong organs or other plants.
This fixed frozen-head stage does not include encoder fine-tuning or a species decoder.
Withheld combinations are few and weakly supported; no reasoning-generalization success claim without independent image labels.
ETA: Slurm estimates start at 07:17 Riyadh on 28 October; provisional queue estimate. Completion ETA awaits measured full-training throughput.
